digest.component_or_area: application-wide operation-scoped configuration and provider authentication composition
propositions: Rebar must resolve one immutable, serializable, non-secret OperationSnapshot at each operation boundary with consistent precedence (explicit operation input > environment > project config > user config > schema default) that remains stable throughout an operation without rereading ambient state

CLI, MCP, Python, and reconciler paths must compose authentication and runtime bindings (GitRuntime, LLMRuntime, BridgeRuntime) exactly once per invocation/operation, with subsystem-local factories retaining provider-native credential lifecycles while Rebar avoids a universal credential store or runtime SSM coupling

Static credentials must be represented only in provider-specific non-serializable Pydantic carriers (SecretStr/SecretBytes) and revealed only at the sending adapter; credentials must never leak into serialization, logging, argv, subprocess environment, exceptions, or sibling processes

Op-cert must accept exactly one of REBAR_OPCERT_KEY_PATH or REBAR_OPCERT_PRIVATE_KEY, validate before service creation, store in a process-owned 0700 directory with 0600 file permissions, and provide context-local signer/principal bindings to jobs without runtime region or boto3 coupling

An AST ownership gate beside check_config_reads.py must derive config and credential names from authoritative registries, reject ambient/aliased config reads and backend reloads below approved seams, permit only exact path+symbol+rationale exceptions, and reach zero legacy exceptions at cutover

Same-capability children must inherit ambient environment for Git/SSH/AWS/proxy compatibility; owning children receive only their adapter overlay; unrelated siblings must not receive exact secret names declared by other Rebar adapters; failures on explicit provider/profile/project auth composition must fail closed without anonymous or alternate-principal fallback
